cohort: Women with a history of vaginal birth or caesarean section who underwent single euploid embryo transfer
finding: Women with a history of caesarean section had a lower likelihood of clinical pregnancy compared to women with a history of vaginal birth after single euploid embryo transfer.
mod_finding: Women with a history of cesarean birth had a lower likelihood of clinical pregnancy after single euploid frozen embryo transfer compared to women with a history of vaginal birth.
